title: ACT OF STATE — Implementation Coverage
measurement: Primary: complexity-weighted, acceptance-aware engineering completion. Secondary: unchanged equal-checkpoint coverage. Each of the 18 original MVP requirements has a documented complexity multiplier; ordinal checkpoint acceptance stages weigh 1, 2, 3, 4. Only independently evidenced binary checkpoints receive any points. Commercial acceptance remains separate.

commercialAcceptance.reviewRule: Only full 4/4 verified requirements are eligible for explicit commercial acceptance; operational, hosted or human checkpoints must not be waived.

requirements.name: Persistent government session

checkpoints.description: Persistent per-owner nation and account session
Password-first login and registration across routes
Authenticated password reset, change and safe logout
Externally verified hosted two-device password/account recovery

requirements.complexityRationale: Persistence and password identity across authenticated user journeys
